title: Ala Industrial
description: A technology mod featuring an EU energy system, machines, generators, and ore processing for Minecraft.
body:
![Ala Industrial banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlaMine-Team-Org/AlaIndustrial/main/docs/branding/banner_1920x768.png) **Ala Industrial** is a technology mod for Minecraft on **Fabric** and **NeoForge** built around a full **EU/FE power system**. Set up your first generators, run copper cables across your base, store energy in a Battery Box, and power industrial machines that open up resource chains vanilla crafting simply does not have.

This mod is about building a base that actually feels industrial. Power does not appear out of nowhere: you **produce** it, **move** it through cables, **lose** part of it over distance, **smooth** it out with storage, and decide which machines get priority. Step by step, your workshop grows into a real energy network. Ala Industrial paces itself. Instead of front-loading late-game complexity, it builds a complete **LV tier** you can actually finish — start with a single Solar Panel and a Macerator that doubles your ore, then grow into a base with steady power, real storage, and machines that pull their weight. Higher voltage tiers open up later. **What's currently included:** * A complete **LV EU/FE energy core** — generators, storage, machine power handling, and network diagnostics * **Five generators**: LV Generator (fuel), Geothermal Generator (lava), Solar Panel, Daylight Solar Panel, and Moonlit Solar Panel * **Copper Cable** with distance-based energy loss, plus an in-world **Network Analyzer** for inspecting and highlighting energy networks * **Battery Box** for energy storage and load balancing between production and consumption * Four LV processing machines: **Macerator, Electric Furnace, Extractor, and Compressor** * **Data-driven machine recipes** with recipe viewer integration, including machine recipe categories in REI * **Ore processing and material conversion** through dust-based production chains * Four custom ore lines — **Tin, Silver, Nickel, and Uranium** — each with standard and deepslate variants, plus raw, dust and ingot forms * **Tempered Iron** — a full material line: ingot, block, a set of five tools and four armor pieces (a soft upgrade over vanilla iron) * **Iron Chest** — an early-game 36-slot storage upgrade over the vanilla copper chest * **Battery Pouch** — the mod's first charged item (see below) * Progression support through **advancements** and in-game `/ala` diagnostics (`version`, `status`, `net`) --- ### 🔋 Battery Pouch — power on the go

The **Battery Pouch** is a carry-along storage bag that runs on EU/FE. It works like a bundle, but with a twist: it holds its charge while you walk around with items inside, and when that charge runs out, the pouch **locks itself shut** until you recharge it. * **Holds up to 128 stacks** of items — twice a vanilla bundle. Right-click with an item in hand to drop it in (it tops up existing stacks first), right-click in the air to pull the top stack back out. * **Carries a 2000 EU charge** that slowly drains while the pouch is in your inventory and has items inside. * **Locks when empty** — you can't put anything in or take anything out until it's recharged. No free storage. * **Recharge it in the Battery Box** — a dedicated charge slot fills the pouch in just a few seconds. --- **Languages:** Ala Industrial currently includes **20 languages** — English, Ukrainian, Russian, Bengali, Vietnamese, German, Dutch, Swedish, Spanish, French, Italian, Indonesian, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
